P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the generated page; it is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on the page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present on the page.

P10.rationale: The oversized '25-30%' numeral functions as a large decorative typographic element, though it is the only such device and is modest in scale.

P11.rationale: No charts, before/after visualisations, or cost-math graphics are present; the '25-30%' is a standalone statistic without any bound data visualisation.

P12.rationale: The layout is sparse with large empty white regions between sections, falling well short of a dense magazine-quality editorial fill.

P13.rationale: The page is largely flat white with only a teal header band and a dark CTA block providing minimal atmospheric variation; no texture is used.

P14.rationale: The dark CTA block at the bottom uses a solid dark background ensuring the URL text is fully legible, though it is a flat colour rather than a photo with scrim.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no imagery at all, so there is no generic stock photography, though the absence of any specific visuals also means no authentic business imagery.

N08.rationale: There are multiple large empty white regions between the header, body text, pull-quote, statistic block, and CTA, creating significant purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo; all text sits on clean solid-colour backgrounds.
